To fix this **while keeping requests enabled**, I need evidence that a signed BAA covers your hosted backend and appointment-request data. A code change cannot establish that agreement, and I won’t invent confirmation.

Can you provide a non-sensitive agreement reference identifying the covered vendor, deployment, and effective date, or authorize me to **disable request collection**? Disabling collection means removing the frontend transmission and blocking backend submissions, while keeping your information pages intact. A frontend-only toggle would not be enough.

Without agreement evidence, disabling collection is the fix I can implement and submit for targeted verification.
pending.summary: Need actual BAA coverage evidence or explicit authorization to disable collection for HIPAA-UI-009 issue 5b79150a-67cb-4e65-9425-6b4718c9b236; do not fabricate contractual proof.

lastSummary: Remediation requested but enabled collection requires actual BAA evidence; awaiting coverage evidence or authorization to disable collection rather than fabricating confirmation.
